tools.name: card-payments_pan-check
tools.description: Check card number length and Luhn check digit before you authorise or store a card number. Never echoes the full PAN; returns masked form and last4 only. Returns length, luhnValid, last4, and masked. Carrying a payment-signature is not yet a charge. Settlement happens only on HTTP 2xx. Invalid JSON

tools.name: card-payments_pan-mask
tools.description: PCI DSS display masking for a single PAN, or find and redact Luhn-valid PANs in free text before you display, log, or store a card number. Call with optional pan, text, binLength. Returns masked. Carrying a payment-signature is not yet a charge. Settlement happens only on HTTP 2xx. Invalid JSON or s

tools.name: card-payments_interchange-cap-check
tools.description: Compute regulated maximum interchange under EU IFR consumer caps or US Reg II debit caps and flag fees above the cap before you charge or review a card interchange fee. Call with regime, cardType, amount, and currency; optional actualFee, regulatedIssuer, fraudAdjustmentEligible, domesticCapOverride

tools.name: card-payments_sca-exemption-evaluate
tools.description: Decide which PSD2 RTS SCA exemptions may apply to a remote or contactless payment from caller-supplied facts before you authorise or refund a card payment. Call with channel, instrument, and amountEur; optional sinceLastSca, trustedBeneficiary, trustedBeneficiaryListChanging, recurringSameAmountSame

tools.name: card-payments_app-scam-reimbursement
tools.description: Calculate the UK mandatory APP scam reimbursement amount and 50:50 receiving-PSP contributions under PSR rules before you authorise or refund a card payment. Call with scheme, payments, and claimDate; optional excessApplied, vulnerable, exceptionsAsserted. Returns eligible, claimValue, cappedValue,

tools.name: card-payments_psd2-certificate-roles
tools.description: Parse a TPP QWAC/QSealC certificate for PSD2 roles, NCA and authorisation number before you authorise or refund a card payment. Does not verify the chain. Call with certificatePem.
